tabs.caption: Command
tabs.content:
# Convert Markdown to Word. Use the quoted optional /work/reference.docx as a third argument for Word styles.
textlt-convert markdown-to-word "/work/Document.md"

tabs.caption: Command
tabs.content:
# Convert Word to Markdown and extract embedded images beside the Markdown file.
textlt-convert word-to-markdown "/work/Document.docx"

tabs.caption: Command
tabs.content:
# Extract the text layer of a PDF as UTF-8 text beside the PDF.
textlt-convert pdf-to-text "/work/Document.pdf"

tabs.caption: Command
tabs.content:
# Format a single JSON value in a separate .formatted.json file.
textlt-convert format-json "/work/Document.json"
